messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] filter chromosomes from methylRaw object
parts:
you can just use subsetting operation []. something like below should work

x[x$chr %in% c("chr1","chr2","chr3"),]

Best,
Altuna
